mapper.sql: fp.function_permission_id as "functionPermissionId", fp.screen_id as "screenId", coalesce(m.menu_name, fp.screen_id) as "screenName", fp.role_code as "roleCode", r.role_name as "roleName", fp.function_type as "functionType", fp.permission_allowed as "permissionAllowed", fp.change_reason as "changeReason", fp.updated_at as "updatedAt"
mapper.select:
select from function_permissions fp left join menus m on m.screen_id = fp.screen_id and m.status = 'ACTIVE' left join roles r on r.role_code = fp.role_code
order by fp.screen_id, fp.role_code, fp.function_type limit #{criteria.safeSize} offset #{criteria.offset}
select count(*) from menus where screen_id = #{screenId} and status = 'ACTIVE' and system_use_yn = 'Y'
select count(*) from roles where role_code = #{roleCode} and status = 'ACTIVE' and system_use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.insert: insert into function_permissions (screen_id, role_code, function_type, permission_allowed, change_reason, created_by, updated_by) values (#{screenId}, #{roleCode}, #{functionType}, #{permissionAllowed}, #{changeReason}, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedBy}) on conflict (screen_id, role_code, function_type) do update set permission_allowed = EXCLUDED.permission_allowed, change_reason = EXCLUDED.change_reason, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by
